meta.name: 查重降AI · 马来西亚中国留学生学术写作辅导知识库
meta.scope: 中国留学生 · 本科 · 马来西亚
meta.positioning: 写作辅导工具（帮学生自己改），非代写工具

universities.framework: 0-4 五级 AI 使用框架（L0禁止/L1极少量语法拼写/L2有限生成想法/L3开放须透明报告/L4整合AI为评估必需）
universities.exam_rule: 笔试原则上禁用 AI；口试/Viva 一律禁止；论文需导师授权并正式声明
universities.penalty: 未在AI政策中单列罚则，纳入既有《学术不端/抄袭》规章处理；未声明AI可能被认定为学术不端
universities.threshold: 未公布统一相似度阈值
universities.key_note: 明确「检测软件不得作为学术不端的唯一定案证据」

universities.framework: L1无AI/L2规划用途/L3协作/L4全程使用/L5探索（改制自 AI Assessment Scale）
universities.exam_rule: 形成性评估可获批使用AI辅助；总结性评估除明确许可外默认禁止
universities.penalty: 三级递进：①书面警告+学术诚信模块可重交扣分；②该作业甚至整门课判零分+上报；③反复/恶劣=停学或开除
universities.threshold: AI 检测 <20% 视为低风险（Level 1）
universities.key_note: 明确AI检测分数为概率性信号，可能误报，不得作为唯一依据；66页指引，全马最详尽之一

universities.ai_stance: 在高校指引框架下审慎、合乎伦理使用，定位「支持而非替代学生角色」
universities.framework: 校层面为通用高教指引；期刊层面 AI 仅可用于提升可读性与语言
universities.penalty: 沿用既有学术不端规章
universities.key_note: 查到的多为期刊出版政策与通用高教指引，未检索到校级《学生GenAI使用政策》原文

universities.ai_stance: 允许作辅助工具，须正式声明
universities.framework: 研究生论文明确：AI为「辅助写作工具，而非原创思考/分析/研究的替代」
universities.exam_rule: 口头答辩时须当场声明AI使用情况
universities.penalty: 未查到专门罚则，违规按学术规章处理

universities.key_note: 须说明在何处、为何使用AI，区分AI生成内容与学生本人贡献；主要覆盖研究生论文/答辩

universities.framework: Pekeliling Akademik Bil.3/2024（2024-03-27生效），适用本科与研究生课程
universities.exam_rule: 作业须标注工具开发商、名称、版本、访问日期、URL；优先采用持续性评估（演示/汇报/辩论/面试）
universities.penalty: 未声明=可归类为抄袭，按《UTM学术规章》处理
universities.key_note: AI不得列为共同作者；政策覆盖教学+科研+出版

universities.ai_stance: 未查到校级统一GenAI成文政策

universities.key_note: 政策模糊/未公开，未检索到校级《生成式AI使用政策》明文

universities.key_note: 未查到公开政策；网传「APU AI政策」多为日本立命馆APU，勿混淆

universities.framework: 《Student Guidelines for Using Generative AI (GenAI) in Academic Work V4》+ 声明表
universities.exam_rule: 须参照校方指引并在作业中作 AI 使用声明
universities.penalty: 未查到公开罚则细则，沿用校学术诚信/纪律程序
universities.key_note: 有专门的学生GenAI指引与声明表；指引PDF需校内权限

universities.ai_stance: 仅查到宣导性文章，非正式政策
universities.key_note: 开放政策库仅含HR/运营类，无学术诚信或AI政策；政策模糊/未公开

universities.ai_stance: 2023版学术手册无GenAI条款，仅有传统抄袭/学术不端规定
universities.exam_rule: 未经授权翻译他人作品、代交等列为抄袭
universities.penalty: 抄袭等学术不端最高可开除（《MMU Students' Discipline Rule》第53条）
universities.key_note: 截至所查2023版手册无GenAI政策；第三方博客说法未见官方原文佐证，不采信

universities.ai_stance: 未查到成文使用政策，工具层面已覆盖AI检测
universities.detection: Turnitin（相似度比对 + AI写作检测）
universities.threshold: AI写作分数<20%标记为较不可靠
universities.key_note: 工具层面已覆盖AI检测；制度层面成文政策未公开

universities.ai_stance: 允许审慎使用 ChatGPT/Bing/Bard 等
universities.framework: 本科生手册明文含AI条款+三份配套文件（AI政策与实践指引/高级AI工具使用指南/AI禁用课程清单）
universities.exam_rule: 参照 MQA 2/2023 通函；有AI禁用课程清单
universities.penalty: 三级递进：①强制心理咨询；②该课程不及格+停学1学期+强制咨询；③开除
universities.threshold: 本科项目可接受相似度上限 ≤ 20%（第4.12条）

universities.ai_stance: 支持「教会学生恰当使用GenAI」理念，分课程规定使用范围
universities.penalty: 未单独查到马来西亚分校罚则，沿用科廷学术诚信程序
universities.key_note: 本部自2026-01-01关闭 Turnitin GenAI 检测

universities.name_zh: 斯威本大学砂拉越分校
universities.ai_stance: 允许在任课教师指示下使用 GenAI 并须恰当致谢
universities.framework: 学生GenAI使用指引（沿用本部）；提交时须附 GenAI 提示与输出清单作为附录
universities.exam_rule: 未获许可或未声明的AI生成作业=学术不端
universities.penalty: 课程不及格、停学或除名；国际学生若被停学/除名可能影响签证
universities.key_note: 有专门学生GenAI指南（需校内Canvas访问）

universities.name_zh: 诺丁汉大学马来西亚分校
universities.ai_stance: 按考核逐项规定「必需/可选/禁止」
universities.framework: 沿用英国本部政策；允许时须致谢并保留AI对话记录
universities.exam_rule: 禁止使用却使用=「虚假署名（False Authorship）」=学术不端
universities.penalty: 使用违规可构成 False Authorship 学术不端，按校《学术不端规章》处理
universities.key_note: 推荐使用校内登录的 Microsoft Copilot

pain_points.pain_point: AI检测报告默认对学生不可见，只能在老师后台看到，学生提交前无法自查AI率
pain_points.scene: 提交作业后能查到的只有重复率，AI率多少、有没有被标记自己完全不知情，直到老师约谈才知道出事
pain_points.quote: AI检测报告默认只有老师后台能看到，学生自己是看不到的……直到老师找你谈话才知道出事了。你能反复自查重复率，却没法提前自查AI率

pain_points.pain_point: 非英语母语/ESL 学生被 AI 检测误判概率显著更高
pain_points.scene: 纯手写也被标红；规整句式、保守用词与AI文本特征重合
pain_points.quote: 斯坦福大学2023年的一项研究显示，非英语母语者写的文章，被AI检测器误判的比例高达61.2%
pain_points.evidence_type: 事实（引用学术研究，二手转述）

pain_points.pain_point: 用 Grammarly 等工具润色后 AI 率飙升，被误判
pain_points.scene: 自己手写初稿AI率仅8%，用Grammarly高级版润色后飙到32%
pain_points.quote: 纯自己写的初稿AI率只有8%，用Grammarly高级版润色完再查，直接飙到32%，连他自己都懵了

pain_points.pain_point: 『中文打草稿→翻译→润色』是最常见写法，但恰恰最容易被判AI
pain_points.scene: 中国留学生先用中文写，DeepL翻译后用Quillbot润色，句式逻辑像中文、用词又标准，酷似AI翻译
pain_points.quote: 这是绝大多数中国留学生的写作方式……被误判的概率特别高，尤其是商科、理工科 Essay，更容易中枪

pain_points.pain_point: AI 率超标导致被约谈/听证会/指控学术不端，产生强烈恐慌
pain_points.scene: 收到学术不端通知邮件，或被叫去非正式会谈，面临F/重修/停学
pain_points.source: 知乎 p/2052786414228713696；studymy.org.cn 学术不端申诉指南
pain_points.quote: 如果你刚刚收到学校发来的学术不端通知，不要慌……AI率偏高被标记，不等于你一定会被处罚

pain_points.pain_point: Turnitin 官方承认 AI 检测有 ±15 个百分点浮动误差，结果本身不可靠
pain_points.scene: 显示30%的文章真实可能是15%，也可能是45%
pain_points.quote: Turnitin官方自己也承认，AI检测结果有±15个百分点的浮动误差……本身就不是个精确数字

pain_points.pain_point: 查重率超标但不会改写/降重，尤其文献综述与研究方法章节重复率最高
pain_points.scene: 文献综述大量引用前人研究，重复率失控；改写只会同义词替换，被判『改写指数』可疑
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 毕业论文格式与查重指南；studymy.org.cn 学术诚信制度解析
pain_points.quote: 文献综述章节往往是查重率最高的部分……单纯替换同义词的降重效果已明显减弱

pain_points.pain_point: 『伪释义』——边看边改几个词，句式与逻辑仍与原文吻合，构成抄袭
pain_points.scene: 打开文献边看边改写，只替换关键词，整体句式逻辑吻合，被判定抄袭
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术诚信制度解析
pain_points.quote: 中国留学生常犯的错误是『伪释义』……这在马来西亚高校的判定中，依然构成抄袭

pain_points.pain_point: 把国内文献翻译后使用仍会被查重，且用百度百科/知乎作论据不可接受
pain_points.scene: 将中文文献翻译成英文使用，或引用百度百科/知乎，被Turnitin标记或不被学术语境接受
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术诚信制度解析
pain_points.quote: Turnitin的比对范围包括中文资料的英译版本，简单地将国内文献翻译后使用，依然会被标记……百度百科或知乎作为论据来源完全不可接受

pain_points.pain_point: AI使用规范模糊——各校政策不一，『允许润色但须声明』，学生怕踩线
pain_points.scene: 马来西亚多数高校尚无专门禁令，但将AI生成内容提交等同于代写；学生不知边界在哪
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术诚信制度解析；Turnitin 吉隆坡圆桌博客
pain_points.quote: 除非教师明确授权，否则使用AI生成内容并作为自己的作业提交，等同于代写，属于严重学术不端

pain_points.pain_point: 自我抄袭/一稿多投在同校不同课程也属违规，学生普遍不知情
pain_points.scene: 把同一份作业提交给不同课程，即便全是自己写的也构成学术不端
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术不端申诉指南；学术诚信制度解析
pain_points.quote: 自我抄袭在马来西亚同样受到严格限制……即使该作品完全由本人完成，也构成学术不端

pain_points.pain_point: 第25%-30% 相似度警戒线模糊，且『单源匹配率』另有更严标准
pain_points.scene: 本科一般要求低于25%，硕士15-20%；博士单源匹配率不得超过3%，学生常只盯总相似度
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术诚信制度解析；毕业论文格式与查重指南
pain_points.quote: 本科生论文的总体相似度通常要求低于25%，研究生论文则更为严格，多数设在15%至20%之间

pain_points.pain_point: 降重/降AI存在大量『野路子』与钓鱼工具，学生花了钱反被认定为刻意掩盖
pain_points.scene: 用翻译法/替换词/打乱句式降AI，被新模型识别，或被认定『刻意掩盖AI使用』加重处分
pain_points.quote: 别信『AI降重/降AI率』的野路子……还可能被认定为『刻意掩盖AI使用』，属于更严重的学术不端

pain_points.pain_point: OCR/公式转换文本排版极度规整，易被整体拉高AI率
pain_points.scene: 理工科手写公式、图表用OCR识别插入论文，排版规整被误判AI，最夸张一例公式部分把整体AI率拉到82%
pain_points.quote: 我见过最夸张的一例，光公式部分就把整体AI率拉到了82%

pain_points.pain_point: 申诉流程陌生、时限紧（7-21天），举证责任落在学生身上
pain_points.scene: 收到指控后不知如何申诉，举证责任在于解释为何出现高重复率/AI率；逾期无法申诉
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术不端申诉指南；知乎 p/2052786414228713696
pain_points.quote: 举证责任往往在于解释为何出现高重复率或数据异常……逾期申请除非有不可抗力证明，否则不予受理

pain_points.pain_point: 学术不端后果涉及签证与毕业——停学/开除会被报告移民局，风险极高
pain_points.scene: 被停学或开除，学校有义务向移民局报告，学生签证可能被缩短或取消；毕业论文抄袭可撤销已授学位
pain_points.source: studymy.org.cn 学术不端申诉指南
pain_points.quote: 2026年第一季度，有47名国际学生因学术不端导致签证被撤销……泰莱大学一名硕士生因论文核心章节抄袭率达62%而被撤销已授予的学位

pain_points.pain_point: 英文essay降AI比中文更难——连接词/指代紧密，乱改破坏逻辑；学术术语与引用格式不能动
pain_points.scene: 改一句容易破坏前后逻辑；methodology/theoretical framework 等固定表达不能乱换；APA引用格式不能被工具改动
pain_points.quote: 英文句子之间连接词、指代关系紧密，改一句容易破坏前后逻辑……References和in-text citation部分不被修改，否则格式乱掉比AI率高更麻烦
pain_points.evidence_type: 事实（服务方教程，可能含营销倾向）

pain_points.pain_point: 同校各学院双率（查重率+AI率）标准不统一，学生信息混乱
pain_points.scene: 普通essay要求similarity index低于10-30%，具体要求各老师不同；AI率红线各校从0-5%到15-30%不等
pain_points.quote: 学校普通essay的要求是similarity index低于10-30%（具体要求各个老师有区别）

chinglish.wrong: In my opinion, I think that...
chinglish.issue: 观点引导语叠加，两种表态词重复，属中式冗余习惯（中文常说『在我看来，我认为』）
chinglish.suggestion: 直接用 I argue / I contend / This paper argues，或删去引导语让论点自己说话

chinglish.wrong: very very important / extremely extremely useful
chinglish.issue: 用副词叠加强调，而非换用更精确的形容词，口语化且显稚嫩
chinglish.suggestion: 改用单一强形容词：crucial / pivotal / critical / indispensable

chinglish.wrong: The reason is because...
chinglish.issue: reason 与 because 语义重叠，中文『原因是……因为』直译
chinglish.suggestion: The reason is that... / This is because... / 直接用 because 引导

chinglish.wrong: repeat again / return back / advance forward / discuss together
chinglish.issue: 动词已含方向或重复义，再加副词属同义重复
chinglish.suggestion: 删去冗余副词：repeat / return / advance / discuss

chinglish.wrong: In recent years, with the rapid development of society, ...
chinglish.issue: 万能开头套话，信息量为零，几乎所有作文同构
chinglish.suggestion: 用具体的时间、现象或数据切入：Since 2018, ... / The rise of X has...

chinglish.wrong: first of all, last but not least, all in all, in a word
chinglish.issue: 口语化套话堆砌，学术写作中显空泛
chinglish.suggestion: 用 First / Finally / In sum / Overall，或直接以论点句替代

chinglish.wrong: make a research / do a research
chinglish.issue: research 作不可数名词，不与 make/do 搭配；研究本身用 conduct
chinglish.suggestion: conduct research / carry out a study

chinglish.wrong: discuss about the issue
chinglish.issue: discuss 是及物动词，无需 about，中文『讨论关于』直译
chinglish.suggestion: discuss the issue / debate the issue

chinglish.wrong: learn knowledge / study knowledge
chinglish.issue: knowledge 不能 learn，只能 acquire/gain/obtain；中文『学习知识』直译
chinglish.suggestion: acquire knowledge / gain knowledge / learn about X

chinglish.wrong: open the light / close the light
chinglish.issue: 中文『开灯/关灯』直译，英语用 turn on/off
chinglish.suggestion: turn on the light / switch off the light

chinglish.wrong: How to say this in English?
chinglish.issue: 疑问句缺主语，中文『怎么说』直译
chinglish.suggestion: How do you say this in English? / What is the English for this?

chinglish.wrong: I very like this theory.
chinglish.issue: very 不能修饰动词，中文『很喜欢』直译
chinglish.suggestion: I like this theory very much. / I am strongly drawn to this theory.

chinglish.wrong: Although..., but...
chinglish.issue: 英语中 although 与 but 不能同现，中文『虽然……但是』直译
chinglish.suggestion: Although X, Y. / X, but Y.（二选一）

chinglish.wrong: Because..., so...
chinglish.issue: because 与 so 不能同现，中文『因为……所以』直译
chinglish.suggestion: Because X, Y. / X, so Y.（二选一）

chinglish.wrong: With the development of..., people's living standard has improved.
chinglish.issue: 『随着……的发展』句式模板化，缺乏具体论据
chinglish.suggestion: 以具体机制或证据开头：Falling infant mortality since 1990 reflects...

chinglish.wrong: more and more students / more and more important
chinglish.issue: 『越来越』直译，口语化且笼统
chinglish.suggestion: a growing number of students / increasingly important / rising

chinglish.wrong: Nowadays, ... / With the rapid development of modern society...
chinglish.issue: Nowadays 起手为典型中式作文开头，信息空泛
chinglish.suggestion: 用具体时间或语境：In contemporary Malaysia, ... / Since the 2020 pandemic, ...

chinglish.wrong: give a suggestion / give an advice
chinglish.issue: advice 不可数，不用 an；give 与 advice 搭配弱
chinglish.suggestion: offer a suggestion / provide advice / recommend that...

chinglish.wrong: pay attention on / focus in
chinglish.issue: 介词搭配错误，应为 pay attention to / focus on
chinglish.suggestion: pay attention to / focus on / concentrate on

chinglish.wrong: according to my opinion
chinglish.issue: according to 只引他人/来源，不引自己观点
chinglish.suggestion: In my view / I believe / From my perspective

chinglish.wrong: affect to / influence on the result（动词误用）
chinglish.issue: affect 为及物动词，不加 to；influence 作动词亦及物
chinglish.suggestion: affect the result / influence the result / have an influence on the result

chinglish.wrong: play an important role in...（滥用）
chinglish.issue: 该短语被无限套用，成为模板填充物，缺乏具体动词
chinglish.suggestion: 改用具体动词：X drives / enables / constrains / shapes Y

chinglish.wrong: Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Thirdly, ... Lastly, ...
chinglish.issue: 序数连接词机械排列，段落沦为清单，缺乏逻辑层级
chinglish.suggestion: 用逻辑关系连接：First / In addition / A further factor is / Finally，或省去显式标记

chinglish.wrong: Moreover, ... Furthermore, ... In addition, ...（连续堆叠）
chinglish.issue: 近义递进词连用，逻辑关系被稀释，读来重复
chinglish.suggestion: 交替使用 Moreover / Also / Beyond this / Equally，并让句子本身承载递进

chinglish.wrong: In conclusion, as mentioned above, to sum up, in a nutshell...
chinglish.issue: 结论段引导语叠加，中文『综上所述』多次出现
chinglish.suggestion: 一段一个收束表达：In sum / Overall / These findings suggest that...

chinglish.wrong: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...（每段硬套）
chinglish.issue: 强行平衡句式，为对仗而配对，观点其实并不对立
chinglish.suggestion: 仅在真正对立/权衡时使用；否则用 However / Conversely / By contrast

chinglish.wrong: It is worth noting that... / It should be noted that...（频繁使用）
chinglish.issue: 提示语滥用，稀释信息密度，属典型论文腔填充
chinglish.suggestion: 直接陈述该内容，或改用 Notably, / Importantly,

chinglish.wrong: The problem was solved by us. / The data was analyzed by the researcher.
chinglish.issue: 无必要使用被动语态，中文习惯『被……』迁移；主动更直接
chinglish.suggestion: We solved the problem. / I analyzed the data.（方法学中被动可保留，但勿滥用）

chinglish.wrong: The implementation of the optimization of the system is necessary.
chinglish.issue: 名词化堆叠（implementation/optimization），动词被抽象化，句意模糊
chinglish.suggestion: The system must be optimized. / We need to optimize the system.

chinglish.wrong: There is a growing tendency for the majority of the students to...
chinglish.issue: there be + 抽象名词 + of 结构，冗长绕口
chinglish.suggestion: Most students now... / Students increasingly...

chinglish.wrong: make an investigation of / conduct an analysis of / perform a comparison of
chinglish.issue: 轻动词 + 名词化结构，啰嗦且书面冗余
chinglish.suggestion: investigate / analyze / compare

chinglish.wrong: a lot of / lots of / plenty of（学术语境）
chinglish.issue: 口语化量词，学术写作不当
chinglish.suggestion: many / numerous / a substantial number of / considerable

chinglish.wrong: good / bad / nice / big / small（无具体性）
chinglish.issue: 笼统评价词，缺乏学术精确度
chinglish.suggestion: effective / beneficial / detrimental / substantial / negligible

chinglish.wrong: get / got（学术语境）
chinglish.issue: get 过于口语，且语义模糊
chinglish.suggestion: obtain / receive / acquire / become / achieve

chinglish.wrong: the society / the nature / the life（抽象名词误加冠词）
chinglish.issue: 泛指抽象概念时误加定冠词，中文无冠词系统迁移
chinglish.suggestion: society / nature / life（泛指）

chinglish.wrong: many researches / several knowledges / various informations
chinglish.issue: 不可数名词误用复数，中文名词无复数形态迁移
chinglish.suggestion: much research / several studies / various pieces of information

chinglish.wrong: a research / an evidence / a feedback
chinglish.issue: 不可数名词误加不定冠词
chinglish.suggestion: a study / a piece of evidence / some feedback

chinglish.wrong: In this essay I will write about...（可写性陈述）
chinglish.issue: 声明『我要写什么』而非直接写，属中文作文习惯
chinglish.suggestion: 直接进入论证：This essay examines... 或直接陈述论点

chinglish.wrong: I think maybe probably it is...
chinglish.issue: 情态词叠加，立场含糊，显得不确定
chinglish.suggestion: I argue that... / It is likely that... / The evidence suggests...

chinglish.wrong: Everyone knows that... / As we all know, ...
chinglish.issue: 诉诸常识，未提供引用，学术论证缺失
chinglish.suggestion: 删除，或补充引用：As Smith (2020) demonstrates, ...

chinglish.wrong: It is undoubted that... / There is no doubt that...
chinglish.issue: 绝对化断言，缺乏限定语，易被质疑
chinglish.suggestion: 加限定：The evidence strongly suggests that... / It is widely accepted that...

chinglish.wrong: The company should be responsible for...（应然陈述未加论证）
chinglish.issue: 直接下价值判断，缺中间论证步骤
chinglish.suggestion: 补论证：Because X, the company bears responsibility for...

chinglish.wrong: He didn't went / She have went
chinglish.issue: 时态错误，助动词后误用动词过去式，中文无时态屈折迁移
chinglish.suggestion: He didn't go / She has gone

chinglish.wrong: In the past ten years, the technology change rapidly.
chinglish.issue: 现在完成/一般时态与时间状语不匹配，主语单复数与动词不一致
chinglish.suggestion: Over the past decade, technology has changed rapidly.

chinglish.wrong: Please give me some good advices about my study.
chinglish.issue: advice 不可数误加 s，study 单复数与语境不符，口语化请求
chinglish.suggestion: I would welcome any advice on my studies.

chinglish.wrong: The data shows that... / The data is...（单复数误判）
chinglish.issue: data 在学术写作中常作复数（datum 的复数），部分语境已语法化为单数，需一致
chinglish.suggestion: The data show that... / The dataset shows...（全篇统一）

chinglish.wrong: I believe the theory which is proposed by Smith is very useful for us to solve the problem.
chinglish.issue: 定语从句冗长、which is 冗余、very useful for us to 结构笨重
chinglish.suggestion: Smith's theory offers a useful framework for solving the problem.

chinglish.wrong: As a student, we should study hard.
chinglish.issue: 主语人称不一致（As a student 单数 vs we 复数），中文泛指迁移
chinglish.suggestion: As students, we should... / As a student, one should...

rewrite_examples.before: In my opinion, I think that online learning is very very good for students.
rewrite_examples.after: Online learning benefits students in several concrete ways.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 删除冗余
rewrite_examples.note: 删去观点引导词叠加与 very very，把笼统评价转为可展开的论点句，便于后续给出具体理由

rewrite_examples.before: With the rapid development of society, more and more people pay attention to mental health.
rewrite_examples.after: Public concern with mental health has grown sharply since 2015, when Malaysia's national health survey first reported a rise in diagnosed anxiety.
rewrite_examples.technique: 增加具体性 + 去套话
rewrite_examples.note: 以具体时间、事件和数据替换『随着……发展』『越来越』等模板开头

rewrite_examples.before: Although the theory is old, but it is still useful for us.
rewrite_examples.after: Although the theory is dated, it still offers a useful analytical lens.
rewrite_examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 删除冗余
rewrite_examples.note: 修正 although/but 同现错误；old/useful for us 改为更精确的 dated / analytical lens

rewrite_examples.before: The research was done by our group, and we found that the result is very important.
rewrite_examples.after: Our group's study found the result to be significant.
rewrite_examples.technique: 主动化 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 删去无必要被动 was done by，合并两个分句；important 在统计语境应为 significant

rewrite_examples.before: Firstly, the cost is high. Secondly, the quality is not good. Thirdly, the service is slow.
rewrite_examples.after: Three linked problems undermine the service: high cost, poor quality and slow response.
rewrite_examples.technique: 合并碎句 + 调整语序
rewrite_examples.note: 将机械清单合并为主题句 + 并列，把序数连接词换成逻辑关系，节奏更自然

rewrite_examples.before: It is important to note that the implementation of the optimization of the system is necessary.
rewrite_examples.after: The system needs to be optimized.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 去名词化
rewrite_examples.note: 删去元话语引导语，拆解 implementation/optimization 名词化堆叠，还原动词

rewrite_examples.before: This paper will delve into the multifaceted nature of the intricate interplay between AI and education.
rewrite_examples.after: This paper examines how AI tools affect classroom assessment in Malaysian secondary schools.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 delve into / multifaceted / intricate interplay 等 AI 腔抽象词，明确研究对象与范围

rewrite_examples.before: Technology plays a crucial role in modern society.
rewrite_examples.after: Digital payments now handle 60% of retail transactions in urban Malaysia.
rewrite_examples.technique: 增加具体性 + 去套话
rewrite_examples.note: 把 plays a crucial role 这一空洞论断替换为可核验的具体事实

rewrite_examples.before: In today's fast-paced world, students need to learn knowledge quickly. Moreover, they should also develop skills. Furthermore, they must adapt to change.
rewrite_examples.after: Students today must acquire knowledge rapidly and keep adapting as conditions shift.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 变换句式节奏
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 fast-paced world 开头与 Moreover/Furthermore 堆叠，合并三句为一，长句承载递进

rewrite_examples.before: It is widely believed that exercise is good for health. Everyone knows that.
rewrite_examples.after: Regular exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease (WHO, 2020).
rewrite_examples.technique: 补充论证 + 去套话
rewrite_examples.note: 把诉诸常识的断言改为带引用的具体结论

rewrite_examples.before: I think maybe probably the government should do something to solve this problem.
rewrite_examples.after: The government could address the problem by tightening emission standards.
rewrite_examples.technique: 加入限定语 + 补充论证
rewrite_examples.note: 删去情态词叠加，把『做点什么』具体化为可操作的举措，同时保留 could 的审慎语气

rewrite_examples.before: The company should be responsible for the pollution. They must be punished.
rewrite_examples.after: Because the company knowingly discharged waste, it bears legal responsibility for the resulting pollution.
rewrite_examples.technique: 补充论证 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 补上因果前提，把价值判断转为有依据的推论；punished 改为更中性的 legal responsibility

rewrite_examples.before: There is a growing tendency for the majority of the students to use social media every day.
rewrite_examples.after: Most students now use social media daily.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去名词化 + 删除冗余
rewrite_examples.note: there be + 抽象名词结构改为直陈主谓，信息量不变而更简洁

rewrite_examples.before: We need to make an investigation of the causes and conduct an analysis of the data.
rewrite_examples.after: We investigated the causes and analysed the data.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去名词化 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 拆解轻动词 + 名词化结构，还原为单一动词

rewrite_examples.before: As we all know, education is very important for a country's development.
rewrite_examples.after: Education strongly predicts a country's long-run economic growth (Hanushek & Woessmann, 2015).
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 补充论证 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 As we all know，把空泛断言转为可引用的实证结论

rewrite_examples.before: The problem is very serious. It affects many people. It needs to be solved as soon as possible.
rewrite_examples.after: The problem affects millions and demands urgent attention.
rewrite_examples.technique: 合并碎句 + 变换句式节奏 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 三句短句合并为一句，用 demands urgent attention 收束，避免同构短句堆叠

rewrite_examples.before: In conclusion, in a nutshell, to sum up, AI is important for education.
rewrite_examples.after: Overall, AI is reshaping how students are assessed.
rewrite_examples.technique: 删除冗余 + 去套话 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去重复收束语，只保留一个，并把 important 落到具体作用上

rewrite_examples.before: On the one hand, AI saves time. On the other hand, AI saves money.
rewrite_examples.after: AI cuts both time and cost.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句
rewrite_examples.note: 两点并非对立，不应套用 on one hand/on the other hand 平衡句式

rewrite_examples.before: The reason is because the data was not collected properly.
rewrite_examples.after: The problem arose because the data were collected inconsistently.
rewrite_examples.technique: 删除冗余 + 精确化用词 + 主动化
rewrite_examples.note: 修正 reason/because 重复，data 复数一致，not properly 改为更具体的 inconsistently

rewrite_examples.before: He didn't went to the library yesterday because he must prepare for the exam.
rewrite_examples.after: He did not go to the library yesterday because he had to prepare for the exam.
rewrite_examples.technique: 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 修正 didn't went 时态错误；过去语境中 must 应改为 had to

rewrite_examples.before: In recent years, with the development of the Internet, online shopping has become more and more popular among the young people.
rewrite_examples.after: Online shopping has grown fastest among young adults since 2018.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 变换句式节奏
rewrite_examples.note: 删去双重套话开头与 more and more，用具体群体与时间替代

rewrite_examples.before: The essay will discuss about the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. It is worth noting that this is a hot topic.
rewrite_examples.after: This essay weighs the benefits of remote work against its costs.
rewrite_examples.technique: 拆分长句 + 去套话 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 修正 discuss about 搭配错误，删去 It is worth noting 元话语与 hot topic 空话

rewrite_examples.before: This is not just about saving money, it's about saving the environment.
rewrite_examples.after: The policy reduces both household costs and carbon emissions.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 not just about... it's about 模板句式，直接列出两个具体效果

rewrite_examples.before: A myriad of studies have shed light on the importance of sleep.
rewrite_examples.after: Numerous studies have linked poor sleep to reduced academic performance.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: a myriad of 改为 numerous；shed light on the importance 改为具体因果结论

rewrite_examples.before: As a student, we should study hard to get a bright future.
rewrite_examples.after: As students, we study hard partly because it widens our career options.
rewrite_examples.technique: 调整语序 + 补充论证
rewrite_examples.note: 修正主谓人称不一致；get a bright future 改为可论证的具体理由

rewrite_examples.before: The implementation of the new policy has caused a significant reduction in the number of accidents.
rewrite_examples.after: The new policy has significantly reduced accidents.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去名词化 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: implementation/has caused a reduction 名词化链缩短，还原为动词 reduced

rewrite_examples.before: Nowadays, many people think that the education system should be changed. I agree with it.
rewrite_examples.after: Public opinion increasingly favours reforming the education system.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 Nowadays 与 I agree with it 这类表态句，把观点融进主句

rewrite_examples.before: The data shows that the result is statistically significant, and it proves our hypothesis is correct.
rewrite_examples.after: The data indicate a statistically significant result, which supports our hypothesis.
rewrite_examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 加入限定语
rewrite_examples.note: data 复数一致；proves 过强，改为 supports；避免宣称『证明』

rewrite_examples.before: In order to better understand the problem, it is important to note that we need more research.
rewrite_examples.after: Understanding the problem requires further research into its causes.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 In order to better understand 与 It is important to note 双重填充，压缩为一句

rewrite_examples.before: The ever-evolving landscape of technology has transformed the way we live and work in today's digital age.
rewrite_examples.after: Mobile computing has changed how Malaysians shop, study and bank.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性 + 变换句式节奏
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 ever-evolving landscape / digital age，落到具体技术、地域与活动，句子由抽象变具体

rewrite_examples.before: The theory which is proposed by Zhang is very useful for us to solve this problem.
rewrite_examples.after: Zhang's theory offers a workable solution to the problem.
rewrite_examples.technique: 拆分长句 + 精确化用词 + 删除冗余
rewrite_examples.note: which is proposed by 改为所有格；very useful for us to 改为 workable，结构紧凑

rewrite_examples.before: Many researches show that feedback is good for learning, but some researches disagree.
rewrite_examples.after: Most studies find that feedback improves learning, although findings on its timing remain mixed.
rewrite_examples.technique: 精确化用词 + 加入限定语
rewrite_examples.note: researches 改为 studies；笼统的 some disagree 改为有分歧点的具体限定

rewrite_examples.before: It is undeniable that climate change is a serious problem that we must face together.
rewrite_examples.after: Malaysia's mean temperature has risen about 0.9°C since 1970, intensifying flood risk along the east coast.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 It is undeniable that 与 we must face together 空话，用具体数据与后果替代

rewrite_examples.before: The study of the cultural influence on consumer behavior was carried out by the researcher, and the result obtained shows that culture has an important effect.
rewrite_examples.after: The study shows that culture strongly shapes consumer behaviour.
rewrite_examples.technique: 主动化 + 去名词化 + 合并碎句
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 was carried out by / the result obtained，合并为一句；an important effect 改为 strongly shapes

rewrite_examples.before: Last but not least, I want to say that protecting the environment is good. In a word, we should protect it.
rewrite_examples.after: Protecting the environment ultimately benefits both public health and the economy.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 删除冗余 + 增加具体性
rewrite_examples.note: 删去 Last but not least / I want to say / In a word，把 good 落到具体受益面

rewrite_examples.before: With the development of the economy, the living standard of people becomes higher and higher, and this phenomenon is very significant in the society.
rewrite_examples.after: Rising incomes have steadily improved living standards across Malaysian cities.
rewrite_examples.technique: 去套话 + 合并碎句 + 精确化用词 + 变换句式节奏
rewrite_examples.note: 删去套话开头与 higher and higher；多个分句合并为一句，避免『现象很显著』这类自证式收尾

meta.name: 文献真实性溯源审查知识库
meta.purpose: 识别 AI 生成的『编造文献』（幻觉引用）—— 即引用了看起来像真、实则不存在或无法核实的文献
meta.positioning: 写作辅导工具：帮学生发现自己文章里的可疑引用，避免因编造文献构成学术不端
meta.honest_scope: 本模块**不做联网核验**（离线运行、无 DOI 数据库访问权限）。它做的是『可疑度筛查』：把看起来像幻觉的引用挑出来，提示你逐条去 DOI/Google Scholar 核查。因此它的结论是『可疑 / 需人工核实』，不是『确定为假』。
reference: GPTZero / Turnitin 均在其技术说明中指出：AI 幻觉引用（fabricated citations）是 AI 写作最典型、也最难被表面语法检查发现的缺陷
学术出版实践中，Crossref 可核验的 DOI 是判断文献真伪的最低成本手段
Retraction Watch 统计：2023-2025 年撤稿论文中相当比例涉及引用链污染

hallucination_patterns.desc: 「et al. + 年份」是 AI 最常编造的引用形态，因为模型只需编出一个像样的姓氏与年份组合
hallucination_patterns.hint: 核对第一位作者是否真实存在、以及该年是否确有该文；常见的幻觉形态是作者姓名组合看起来合理但从无合作

hallucination_patterns.pattern: (Journal of Advanced|Journal of Modern|International Journal of|Research in|Studies in)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+\s+){0,3}(Studies|Research|Science|Technology|Management|Education|Economics|Analysis|Innovation|Perspectives)
hallucination_patterns.desc: AI 倾向生成「国际某某研究杂志」这类听起来权威但可能根本不存在的期刊名
hallucination_patterns.hint: 去 ISSN 门户或 JCR 名单查该期刊是否真实收录；不存在于任何数据库的刊名高度可疑

hallucination_patterns.desc: DOI 是 AI 幻觉的重灾区：格式看似标准，但后缀常过短、只含字母，实际并不存在
hallucination_patterns.hint: 把 DOI 粘到 doi.org 或 Crossref 查询——真 DOI 会立即解析；查不到的几乎可确定为编造

hallucination_patterns.desc: 顶刊常被 AI 拿来当『权威背书』，但给出的卷期页码往往对不上
hallucination_patterns.hint: 顶刊文献需精确到卷/期/页码核对，AI 编造的页码常与真实论文不符

hallucination_patterns.desc: 出现具体百分比但附近没有引用标记，是 AI 编造数据与真实学术写作的分水岭
hallucination_patterns.hint: 学术写作中每一个具体数字都应有来源；找不到出处的数字必须删除或补引用

hallucination_patterns.desc: 『研究表明/研究发现』却不说谁的研究 —— AI 极爱用这种『有背书但无出处』的句式
hallucination_patterns.hint: 补上具体作者与年份（如 Smith et al., 2021），否则删除该论断

hallucination_patterns.desc: 『越来越多的研究』『大量研究表明』也是无出处的模糊背书，AI 高频句式
hallucination_patterns.hint: 改为引用 2-3 篇具体文献，或删去该笼统论断

hallucination_patterns.desc: AI 编造引用时高度偏好少数几个常见姓氏，同一篇文章里反复出现同一批『万能作者』极可疑
hallucination_patterns.hint: 检查文中引用的作者是否集中在极少数常见姓氏上；真实文献综述的作者谱通常更分散

fabrication_signals.note: 以下信号用于加权『编造风险分』，非独立判定依据

signals.desc: 文中出现大量引用标记却没有任何参考文献列表
正文有 (Author, 2020) 形式标记，但文献列表里找不到对应条目
文献列表有条目，但正文从未引用过它
有 DOI 字样但格式不完整（缺 10. 前缀或后缀过短）
具体统计数字附近无任何引用标记
引用作者过度集中在少数常见姓氏
出现未来年份或不合理久远的引用年份

verification_guide.title: 手动核验清单（本工具做不到的，必须你自己做）
steps: 把每个 DOI 复制到 https://doi.org —— 能解析 = 真实存在
作者+年份+标题丢进 Google Scholar —— 找不到完全匹配 = 高度可疑
期刊名到 https://portal.issn.org 或 Scopus 期刊列表 —— 查不到 ISSN = 期刊可能不存在
顶刊文献到 PubMed/官网核对卷期页码
核对参考文献列表与正文引用是否一一对应（正文有的列表要有，列表有的正文要引）
数字类论断：找到原始出处，找不到就删掉数字或标注为估算
verification_guide.disclaimer: 本工具不联网、不查 DOI 数据库，无法给出『真假』结论。它只负责把可疑引用挑出来，降低你漏检的概率。最终核验责任在作者本人。

meta.purpose: 作业格式规范检查库：APA 7 / MLA 9 引用格式 + 文章结构完整性
meta.rule_source: APA 7th edition（apastyle.apa.org 官方参考指南）+ MLA 9th edition（MLA Handbook 9th ed.）
meta.boundary: 仅做**离线形态检查**，判断引用条目是否符合格式骨架、结构是否齐全；不联网核验文献真伪，也不替代导师的评分标准。输出为『建议核对』级别，不是判分。

styles.name: APA 第 7 版
styles.used_by: 心理学、教育学、商科、会计、社会科学（马来西亚高校商科/会计作业常用）

in_text_rule.summary: （姓, 年）括注；引用原文另加页码（姓, 年, p. 页码）
key_rules: 两位作者在正文中每次都要写全，用 & 连接（括注内用 &，句子里用 and）
三位及以上作者，从**第一次出现**起就用 et al.
同姓同年的不同文献用 a/b/c 区分：（Smith, 2020a）

reference_rule.summary: 作者. (年). 标题. 来源, 卷(期), 页码. DOI
key_rules: 参考文献列表按作者姓氏**字母顺序**排列
每条使用**悬挂缩进** 0.5 英寸（hanging indent）
作者写法：姓 + 名字首字母（Smith, J. A.）
两位到二十位作者全部列出；最后一位前加 &
**二十一位及以上**作者：列前十九位 + 省略号（…）+ 最后一位作者
期刊名、卷号用**斜体**；文章标题不用斜体、不倾斜
文章标题只大写首词首字母（句中首字母大写，sentence case）
**DOI 后不加句点**，DOI 写成 https://doi.org/ 形式
无 DOI 时，新版 APA 不建议写数据库名或期刊主页 URL
无日期用 (n.d.)

checks.hint: APA 参考文献每条都应包含 (年份) 或 (n.d.)，缺年份通常意味着条目不完整。

checks.desc: 作者名未用首字母形式
checks.note: 只在条目开头检查：APA 要求 姓, 首字母.
checks.hint: APA 作者应写成「姓, 名首字母.」如 Smith, J. A.；写成全名 Smith, John 不符合规范。

checks.desc: DOI 未写成 https://doi.org/ 形式
checks.hint: APA 7 要求 DOI 写成完整链接 https://doi.org/10.xxxx/yyyy，不要只写 10.xxxx/yyyy。
APA 7 明确规定 **DOI 后不加句点**。加了是常见扣分点。

checks.desc: 使用了过时的 Retrieved from
checks.hint: APA 7 已**取消** Retrieved from（第 6 版的写法）。除少数会变动的网页外，不应再使用。

checks.desc: 参考文献列表中误用 et al.（APA 参考文献应列全作者）
checks.hint: APA 参考文献列表**不使用 et al.**（除 21 位以上作者用省略号）；et al. 只能用在正文引用里。

styles.name: MLA 第 9 版
styles.used_by: 文学、语言、人文、文化研究（英语专业、通识写作）

in_text_rule.summary: （作者 页码）括注，**不带年份、不带逗号**
key_rules: 正文引用是「姓 页码」，**中间不加逗号**，不用年份
没有页码时才用别的定位（如章节名），不要编页码
与其他体系混用时最容易错的就是这里（写成 APA 的「Smith, 2020」）

reference_rule.summary: 九大核心要素，按序排列，能填则填
core_elements: 2. Title of Source 来源标题
3. Title of Container 容器标题
key_rules: 参考文献页标题固定为 **Works Cited**（居中，不加引号、不斜体）
条目按作者姓氏**字母顺序**排列
每条使用**悬挂缩进** 0.5 英寸
**自足作品**（书、整部电影）标题用**斜体**
**较大作品的一部分**（文章、短篇、单集）标题用**引号**
两位作者：只倒置第一位（Dorris, Michael, and Louise Erdrich）
**三位及以上**作者：第一位 + et al.
无作者：从标题开始排
**容器**（container）是承载来源的更大整体（期刊、网站、选集）
引用 AIGC/工具时也有规范（MLA 已发布 ChatGPT 引用指引）

checks.desc: MLA 正文引用混入了 APA 式年份
checks.hint: MLA 正文引用不写年份，格式是（Smith 15）。出现（Smith, 2020）说明混用了 APA。

checks.desc: MLA 正文引用在姓与页码之间误加逗号
checks.hint: MLA 是（Smith 15），姓与页码之间**不加逗号**。

checks.desc: 参考文献页标题不是 Works Cited
checks.note: 由模块单独判定：若用 MLA 但标题写成 References，提示改。
checks.hint: MLA 的参考文献页标题应为 Works Cited（APA 才叫 References）。
MLA 9 推荐用 https://doi.org/10.xxxx 或 DOI 后的稳定链接，不写 doi: 前缀。

structure.name: 文章结构完整性

core_sections.name: Introduction 引言
core_sections.purpose: 交代背景、引出议题、点明主旨（thesis statement）
signals: 开篇段落含背景/现象描述
出现 thesis / 论点句（常见于首段末句）
常见标记词：This essay/report/paper examines/argues… · The purpose of this … · In recent years…

core_sections.name: Body 主体
core_sections.purpose: 分论点 + 论据 + 分析，通常 ≥2 段
signals: 多个段落各承载一个分论点
常见标记词：First/Firstly… · Moreover/Furthermore… · For example… · On the other hand…

core_sections.name: Conclusion 结论
core_sections.purpose: 总结论点、回应引言、给出结论或建议
signals: 常见标记词：In conclusion… · To conclude… · In summary… · Overall… · To sum up…

structure.boundary: 结构判定基于段落排布与标记词，属**启发式提示**。分点式（bullet）作业、诗歌、代码报告等非典型文体可能不适用，此时会标注『结构本项不适用』而非判缺失。

common_mistakes.title: 正文引用与参考文献不匹配（dangling / orphan）
common_mistakes.detail: 正文引了但参考文献里没有，或参考文献里有但正文从没引用。两端必须一一对应。

common_mistakes.title: 把 APA 与 MLA 混着用
common_mistakes.detail: 最常见：正文用（Smith 15）却把参考文献页写成 References；或正文带年份但参考文献不列。**一篇作业只能用一种体系。**

common_mistakes.title: 参考文献页缺悬挂缩进 / 未按字母排序
common_mistakes.detail: Word 里需手动设置 0.5 英寸悬挂缩进；条目要严格按姓氏字母序，不能按引用先后排。

common_mistakes.title: DOI 格式错误
common_mistakes.detail: APA 7：写成 https://doi.org/xxxx 且**末尾不加句点**；只写 10.xxxx 或写成 doi: 都不规范。

common_mistakes.title: 标题大小写与斜体错误
common_mistakes.detail: APA 文章标题用 sentence case、不斜体，期刊名斜体；MLA 自足作品斜体、文章用引号。

common_mistakes.title: 结构缺 Conclusion
common_mistakes.detail: 只写完主体就收尾，没有回扣主旨的结论段。多数评分标准里这是硬性扣分项。

common_mistakes.title: 套用旧版规范
common_mistakes.detail: 如 APA 6 的 Retrieved from、MLA 8 的固定标签格式，在 7/9 版里已改。确认导师要求的是哪一版。

guide.title: 格式自查清单（打印出来对着改）
steps: 确认导师要求的是 APA 还是 MLA、第几版（APA 7 / MLA 9 为现行版本）
检查正文引用的括注格式：APA 带年份（Smith, 2020）；MLA 只带页码（Smith 15）
检查参考文献页标题：APA 用 References；MLA 用 Works Cited
检查条目是否按作者姓氏字母排序、是否设置了 0.5 英寸悬挂缩进
检查条目作者写法：APA 用首字母（Smith, J. A.）；MLA 只倒置第一位作者
检查 DOI：APA 写成 https://doi.org/xxxx 且末尾无句点；MLA 不写 doi: 前缀
逐条核对正文引用与参考文献是否一一对应（不悬空、不孤立）
检查结构：有没有 Introduction、Body（≥2 段分论点）、Conclusion
确保全文只用一种引用体系，不要 APA/MLA 混用
